analogue: Gas-phase OH addition to o-cresol-derived 3-methylcatechol and successive phenolics produces more oxygenated toluenes and methylbenzoquinones, some of which enter particles.
citation: Formation of highly oxygenated low-volatility products from cresol oxidation
evidence: CIMS and particle DART-MS detected later-generation oxygenated products from cresol oxidation. Separate 3-methylcatechol oxidation experiments traced the next generation of products.
difference: V_C pools compounds spanning many volatilities and the single irreversible S_C flux omits explicitly oxidant-dependent rates, multiple generations and repartitioning.
